product.name: Flight Booking
product.description: A platform for searching and booking flights worldwide, including options for one-way, round-trip, and multi-city travel.

product.name: Hotel Booking
product.description: A service to search and book hotel accommodations worldwide, including hotels, villas, apartments, and resorts.

product.name: Car Rental
product.description: A service for renting vehicles from trusted partners, available for various durations and locations.

product.name: Airport Transfer
product.description: A service providing transportation between airports and destinations, tailored to user schedules and locations.

product.name: Activities and Experiences Booking
product.description: A platform to discover and book various activities, tours, and attractions worldwide.
